row.evidence: Eden's pricing page puts 'Employee directory sync' and 'Single Sign-On or Directory Syncing' in Scale ($179/month/location) and checks SCIM only for Scale and Enterprise, not Accelerate ($89).
row.notes: Per-location pricing (Visitor Management tab, the default; annual shown, monthly $109/$209), so per-user fields are null and no multiplier. SCIM, SAML, Okta and Azure AD rows are checked for Scale and Enterprise but not Accelerate (read from the pricing table markup); on the Room Scheduling tab 'Sign-On and Directory Syncing' sits in Enterprise (Contact Us). Directory sync runs through Eden's own Okta/Google/Azure connections or the WorkOS portal for other providers (help article titled 'Directory Sync Instructions (SCIM)'); Eden does not publish a SCIM endpoint itself, so generic is null and Okta/Entra/Google are recorded as directory_sync. Deactivation in the directory deactivates the Eden user. SSO alone provisions JIT on first sign-in but does not deactivate. Okta's OIN app 'Eden Workplace' is SWA only. Public API has no user endpoints. Category: workplace/visitor management filed under IT Management & Endpoint (closest fit).

plans.name: Accelerate
plans.notes: SSO/SCIM cells empty for Accelerate in the pricing table markup.

scim.notes: Directory sync via Eden's Okta/Google/Azure connections or the WorkOS portal; JumpCloud SCIM additionally requires JumpCloud SSO.

custom.how: Location rules, user groups and preferred name need Eden Customer Success to configure.

attributes.notes: Attribute names paraphrased from the help article (name, email, job title, phone number, manager); exact SCIM paths not documented.

limitations.text: Every synced user needs at least one location; assign via location rules after connecting.
Directory cannot be unlinked from the dashboard; contact the CSM.
JumpCloud SCIM requires SSO through JumpCloud too.
Initial sync can take up to two hours.
With directory sync on, CSV updates are limited to wellness and reservation eligibility fields.

user_api.notes: Public API covers locations, reservations, access logs, visitor invites and tickets; no user-management endpoints.

okta.notes: OIN 'Eden Workplace' app marks only SWA as checked (page markup). Eden's own docs describe an Okta directory sync connection set up from the Eden dashboard.

entra.notes: From Eden's help centre (Azure connection from the Eden dashboard); no Entra gallery tutorial found.

jumpcloud.notes: Via the WorkOS portal (Eden says JumpCloud SCIM/Directory needs JumpCloud SSO too); JumpCloud catalogue page not reachable (403).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS sync (BambooHR, Gusto, Workday, Rippling, HiBob) and Slack-based JIT
